name: How long does a garage remodel usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage remodel usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a garage remodel project varies depending on its complexity and the extent of changes. A basic renovation involving new paint, flooring, and storage solutions might take a few days to a couple of weeks. More extensive remodels, such as converting a garage into an accessory dwelling unit (ADU) or adding significant structural modifications, can take several weeks to a few months. Maine Results, Inc. works with clients in areas like Eagle and Meridian to establish a realistic timeline from the initial design phase through to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on complexity; basic remodels take days to weeks, while extensive conversions can take several weeks to months.
